scenarios.expected: Reference matches role limits, configured versus fixed concepts and actual file behavior.
scenarios.actual: Compared the permissions row with the app. The Administrator read the organization's configured contract types and opened a Confidential Contract created by the Legal Team Member, which is the row's reach. The account roles actually in use are administrator, business_user, contributor and legal_team_member, with no deployment-operator account role, so the operator row's "not an additional app account role" is accurate.

scenarios.expected: Reference matches role limits, configured versus fixed concepts and actual file behavior.
scenarios.actual: Checked the reference against the actual controls. Organization settings answered 403 "You do not have permission to perform this action." for this role while her own preference pane opened, which is the row's Administrator-only sentence. The Move to list showed each configured Status label beside its fixed Stage, including the seed's renamed "Signed, awaiting countersignature" against Signature. The key date form offers Date, Event and an optional Note with no assignee, while the task form offers Title, Assignee and an optional Due date, so Task due dates and Key dates are not equated. The Entities module lists our own Helix companies while the Contract overview carries separate "Our entity" and "Counterparties" fields. Adding a second Version reached v2 and the comparison appended nothing, so a Comparison is not a Version. An SVG was offered as a plain download link with no reading panel while a PDF opened the panel and drew "Page 1 of 1"; a seeded Word document rendered as a converted PDF and Download returned the original .docx. A 105 MiB upload was refused with "over the 100 MB upload limit" and nothing was stored.
